build_visdial_model: build a VisDialMultiModalModel by instantiating it with a config and calling build to initialize all components
init_text_embedding: initialize text and history embeddings for the VisDialMultiModalModel using the _init_text_embedding method
forward_visdial: run the forward pass with texts, answer options, histories, image features, and image dims to get logits
combine_embeddings_visdial: combine image, text, and history embeddings using the multi_modal_combine_layer via combine_embeddings
calculate_logits_visdial: calculate logits from a joint embedding by passing it through the VisDialDiscriminator decoder
